headline: Reuters reports Anthropic’s cloud marketplace revenue concentration and compute commitments
summary: Reuters reported from a confidential Anthropic IPO filing it reviewed that Amazon and Google cloud marketplaces routed about 47% of Anthropic’s 2025 sales, with approximately $351 million in distribution fees. Reuters also reported $54.6 billion in non-cancellable hosting and computing commitments at end-2025 and more than $417 billion in total long-term commitments by early 2026. The accessible source is a Reuters republication; the confidential filing, calculations and fulfillment of commitments were not independently verified.
